COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
20.11.2024 CLCON NO.382 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J. 
This Contempt Petition has been filed 
alleging the wilful disobedience of an order 
dated 20.02.2024, passed in Writ Petition 
S/S No.904 of 2021. By the said order, the 
following direction was issued,
“16. I found force in the writ petition 
filed by the petitioner. The writ petition 
is hereby allowed. A mandamus is 
issued to the respondent no.2, to grant 
ACP (s) to the petitioner from the date 
of his entitlement with effect from 
08.10.2009 i.e. 2nd ACP and 3rd ACP 
with effect from 08.10.2017, 8 years 
after grant of 2nd ACP. The respondent 
no.2, shall pay the arrears of the 2nd 
and 3rd ACP to the petitioner within a 
period of one year in three instalments.”
2. Mr. Piyush Tiwari, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
3. Notice is issued to the respondent. 
Steps to be taken within a week. 
4. List on 10.02.2025.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
20.11.2024 
Pant/
